name: Lars
summary: At a small camp on the northern edge of the Hushed Bank, Lars and Sven Yorgen struggle to survive Duskwood. Beasts, undead, and worgen roam the surrounding woods.

sections.title: A Precarious Perch
sections.body: Lars keeps to a small camp on the northern edge of the Hushed Bank, far from the uncertain safety of Darkshire. Duskwood is dangerous, with ferocious beasts, undead, and worgen in the woods. He stays close to Sven Yorgen and tries to endure the forest.

sections.title: Threat from the Wilds
sections.body: Starving dire wolves prowl near Lars and Sven's camp. Lars cannot keep watch or drive them off alone, so he relies on travelers to thin their packs before the predators overrun the camp.

faq.answer: Lars is a human survivor who camps in Duskwood with his companion Sven Yorgen. Together they endure the forest's dangers on the northern edge of the Hushed Bank.
Lars stays at a small camp on the northern edge of the Hushed Bank in western Duskwood.
Hungry dire wolves and other predators threaten Lars and Sven's camp. Lars asks passing travelers to hunt the wolves before they overrun it.

faq.q: What is Lars's relationship to Sven Yorgen?
faq.answer: Lars and Sven Yorgen are companions surviving together in the wilderness. Sven has a dark history and a vendetta in the region, while Lars helps keep their isolated camp going.

angles.text: As a champion of the Alliance, you can help Lars, a human civilian beyond the town guard's reach, by driving off the wolves circling his camp.
